_comment: Shared seam contract between Notes9 (Next.js) and Catalyst (AI). This exact file is committed to BOTH repos and each side has a conformance test asserting its own constants match it. If you widen a value here, the other repo's test goes red on its next build, which is the point. See docs/arch/catalyst-seam-determinism/CONTRACTS.md in the Notes9 repo.

limits._rule: Where the two repos currently disagree, the SMALLER value wins, because the smaller one is what production already enforces: Notes9 defaults LIMITS_MODE to shadow, so Catalyst's pydantic is the effective ceiling and the user receives a raw 422.

sse_notes.text_reset: Instructs the client to DISCARD its accumulated token buffer and restart. A client that ignores this renders corrupted text. It is absent from API_DOCUMENTATION.md, which documents 5 of these 20 events.
sse_notes.clarify: Terminal. Its question is NOT also streamed as token events, so rendering the card does not double-render text.
sse_notes.done: Authoritative. Its content supersedes the accumulated token buffer. An error stream ends error then done, never a bare error.
sse_notes.ping: Sent as the very first frame before any await, to commit response headers. Clients must tolerate a leading ping.
